current_command.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; Set-Location (Resolve-Path '.').Path; git add -A; $staged=(git diff --cached --name-only); if($staged){ git commit -m 'chore: record shutdown environment diagnosis' | Out-Host }; git push origin main | Out-Host; $local=(git rev-parse HEAD).Trim(); $remote=(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main | ForEach-Object { ($_ -split '\s+')[0] }).Trim(); if($local -ne $remote){ throw ('REMOTE_HEAD_MISMATCH local='+$local+' remote='+$remote) }; $dirty=(git status --porcelain); if($dirty){ throw ('WORKTREE_NOT_CLEAN count='+($dirty | Measure-Object).Count) }; Write-Output ('GIT_SYNC_OK head='+$local); $env:USERNAME=[Environment]::UserName; $env:USERDOMAIN=[Environment]::UserDomainName; if(-not $env:USERNAME -or -not $env:USERDOMAIN){ throw 'WINDOWS_IDENTITY_ENV_NOT_RESOLVED' }; $since=Get-Date; & 'C:\Windows\System32\shutdown.exe' /s /f /t 15; $code=$LASTEXITCODE; if($code -ne 0){ throw ('SHUTDOWN_COMMAND_FAILED exit='+$code) }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $ev=Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; Id=1074; StartTime=$since.AddSeconds(-2)} -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if(-not $ev){ Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $ev=Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; Id=1074; StartTime=$since.AddSeconds(-2)} -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 }; if(-not $ev){ throw 'SHUTDOWN_EVENT_1074_NOT_FOUND' }; Write-Output ('SHUTDOWN_EVENT_CONFIRMED id='+$ev.Id+' time='+$ev.TimeCreated.ToString('o')+' provider='+$ev.ProviderName); Write-Output 'WAITING_FOR_POWER_OFF'; Start-Sleep -Seconds 30; Write-Output 'ERROR_HOST_STILL_RUNNING_AFTER_SHUTDOWN_DEADLINE'; exit 2"
